name: web-blue-cta-block-with-newsletter-and-link-columns-footer
title: Footer with a big royal-blue banner 'Build Tastefully Crafted UIs' over a newsletter field, link columns and social icons
whatItIs: A white page with a large royal-blue rounded rectangle holding a bold white centred headline, and below it a Newsletter block with an email input and black Submit, a row of grey social icons and a copyright, and three link columns (Product, Company, Social).
whatItMeans: Bold and tidy; one colour block leads into a plain footer.
techniques: Lead the footer with a large colour CTA block.
Follow with a newsletter and link columns.
Use black for the submit button.

vocabulary.definition: A colour block with a single headline.
An email field with a submit button.
A heading and list of footer links.
A row of small platform icons.
